correctness.rationale: For each connected path interval, the projected intrinsic normal length is c_q=sqrt(q(2n-1-q)/(2n-1)). Two end singletons and all n-1 adjacent pairs cover every coordinate twice, so sum support=2 gives r<=2/(2c2+2c3+(n-3)c4). The explicit z0 saturates them, while strict concavity of c_q makes all longer interval inequalities feasible. Equality forces covering facets tight; singleton slacks at positions 2 and n-1 vanish; each remaining sigma_i, 3<=i<=n-2, lies in [0,r(2c4-c3-c5)]. Discrete secant monotonicity bounds slack losses on every other interval, giving an injective independent (n-4)-box. Limit n*r_n=1.
